name: Jack Fairman
features: greying hair, heavy jaw, solid build, unflappable weathered face
bio: The professional stand-in: Connaught, Vanwall, BRM, anything that needed a steady man. Shared the 1959 Nurburgring 1000 km victory with Moss in the Aston Martin, having famously pushed the car out of a ditch single-handed to keep it running.
